rationale: Dorea formicigenerans ferments available carbohydrates (maltose, inositol) and amino acids (arginine for N; cysteine for C/N). Fermentation yields butyrate, acetate, formate, CO₂, and H₂. Carbon balance: 156 mmol in (malt 90 + inost 33 + arg 14.4 + cys 8.4) covers 16.5 mmol growth + ~139 mmol fermentation products. Nitrogen: 12 mmol in covers 3.5 mmol growth + amino acid catabolism. Growth rate 0.50 /h is conservative, consistent with substrate limitation and prior turns 4–5 pattern.
